svg.title: FAPI 2.0 Security Profile and its related specifications
svg.desc: A hub-and-spoke map with FAPI 2.0 at the centre. Solid lines connect required specifications: OAuth 2.0 core, the OAuth security BCP, TLS recommendations, pushed authorization requests, PKCE, authorization server metadata, and three one-of choices for client authentication, sender-constrained tokens and authorization response integrity. Dotted lines connect optional specifications: JAR, OpenID Connect, RAR, JWT access tokens, introspection and revocation, and message signing.
